name: Gearbox
text: I'll pull the latest EXCAVA performance logs from `/var/log/excava/perf/` and cross-check them against the manufacturer's spec sheets in `/opt/gearbox/excava/models/` to identify the top 0.5% bottleneck. Then I'll run a targeted benchmark with `excava-bench -m hybrid -t 1000 -d /dev/sdX` on the test rig to validate any gains before pushing the artifact to `/opt/gearbox/artifacts/excava-power-up/`.

name: Torque
text: Torque: Hold—your "targeted benchmark" risks conflating *simulated* hybrid mode with *real* workloads. The `/dev/sdX` flag is a blunt instrument; EXCAVA’s bottlenecks may lie in I/O contention or thermal throttling, not compute. Where’s the evidence that hybrid mode even engages the correct subsystems? Pull the actual power draw logs *during* the benchmark—if they don’t spike where the spec sheets predict, your "0.5%" gain is a placebo.
